hints.title: Couple Partition Graph
hints.text: Model each couple as a node and each adjacent seat pair as an edge between the couples seated there.

hints.title: Cycle Resolution Swaps
hints.text: Resolving a cycle of size k couples requires exactly k minus one swaps.

hints.title: Connected Components Formula
hints.text: Group couples into connected components using disjoint set union. The total swaps required is the total number of couples minus the number of connected components.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of couples (half of row length)
complexity.notes: Disjoint set union over N couple nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible swap sequences takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent array of size N tracks components in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map people 2k and 2k+1 to couple ID k and count disjoint components.
